text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
âDid you see that?
Mom... Dad...
choice_data_list: You were there to see them both through to the end, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
!
...I see.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: How did it look to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: This Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on 1st place,
Espoir City-san!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: To think you, who usually raced at the mile and medium distances, would suddenly enter a sprint! It was quite a surprise, but—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: In short, what do you think was the deciding factor in your victory!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh~? Key to victory...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I've been relentlessly honing my racing instincts
all this time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I honed my speed considerably, and I was confident in a contest of explosive power.
...I think my timing to make a move was good, too."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...! That's an amazing self-analysis...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Don't butt in so suddenly!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu...! You two get along so well.
...Then, for such a Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Umamusume
is Espoir City-san to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What kind of Umamusume was she?
At first, I thought she was an Umamusume who couldn't focus. Then I realized she was just trying too hard to act tough.

I wanted to give her confidence,
so I made up the lie about being the 'strongest Umamusume.'
...Though that lie eventually got exposed.
Every day spent with her was a learning experience.

The joy of teaching, and the hardships of it, too.
As well as the delight of standing beside her as she grows.
—She taught me everything.
choice_data_list: Espo is— truly a strong Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: She's an Umamusume strong enough to fight even without me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Fools.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Without you, the Espoir City standing here wouldn't exist.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm only here because of you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you ever forget, Trainer.
Just who it was that you raised.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Remember this—remember me winning today.
Don't ever forget the joy of this day.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —'Cause everything is right here inside me 'n you.
